projects.title: Notebook Reproducibility
projects.body: Reproducibility pipeline supporting Codeberg, Zenodo, and GitHub with FAIR analysis and AI-based notebook categorization.
description: An extension of a notebook reproducibility pipeline that adds support for Codeberg and Zenodo alongside the existing GitHub integration. The goal is FAIR-compliant analysis across multiple platforms.
The project introduces AI-based categorization of Jupyter notebooks using LLMs, automated metadata extraction, and cross-platform reproducibility checks.
The stack uses Python, SQLite for local storage, RDF/SPARQL for semantic queries, and nbformat for notebook parsing — shaped as a research-grade open source tool.

projects.title: Saporini Italiano
projects.body: POS terminal, KDS, and admin dashboard — Next.js on the web, Spring Boot on the server, and Kotlin Multiplatform for mobile and desktop.
description: A full restaurant management system covering the POS terminal for order taking, a Kitchen Display System for order flow, and an admin dashboard for menu management and analytics.
The web surface is built with Next.js and TypeScript. The backend runs on Spring Boot with PostgreSQL. The monorepo is managed with Turborepo and containerized with Docker.
Mobile and desktop clients are powered by Kotlin Multiplatform, sharing business logic across platforms while delivering native performance on each target.

projects.title: AED Fiskal
projects.body: Developed a gas station management and fiscalization platform for handling fuel sales, fiscal receipts, payments, pump operations, and transaction reporting.
description: AED Fiskal is a gas station management and fiscalization platform built to support fuel sales, fiscal receipts, payments, pump operations, and transaction reporting.
The system uses Spring Boot, Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and a microservices architecture, with Kafka, Redis, and WebSockets supporting real-time operations and communication.
This was an internal company system, so no public website or GitHub repository is available.

projects.title: 360° Deutsch
projects.body: Immersive German-learning platform with 3D/AR rooms in Three.js and WebXR for contextual language practice.
description: An immersive German-learning platform that places learners inside interactive 3D and AR rooms built with Three.js and WebXR — delivering language practice in realistic, contextual environments.
The backend is built with FastAPI and uses both PostgreSQL for relational data and GraphDB with RDF/SPARQL for semantic knowledge graphs that power contextual vocabulary and grammar suggestions.
The frontend is built in React/Next.js, combining 3D scene management with standard web UI for lesson flows, progress tracking, and adaptive content delivery.
